coverage_note: Type counts recurse into table column/cell descriptors as well as renderable nodes. These counts do not imply renderer support or qualification.

type_styles.use: Inline numbers, secondary metrics, card numbers

rules: A 5-up band shares only its outer edges with 12-column content above or below; separate the bands by a rule or at least 18 pt rather than stacking 12-column inner edges flush against 5-up ones.
Columns are equal and span one or two; vertical rhythm (18 pt rows) is unchanged.
Content inside a 5-up column sits on the 18 pt lattice measured from that column's start.

components.name: Text
components.summary: A run of text in one type style and one ink role. Every other text in the system is this primitive.
components.pptx_contract: Text box with exact line spacing (spcPts) and zero insets unless a component sets them.

components.name: Surface
components.summary: A filled rectangle with square corners. Seven surfaces, each with its own ink roles.
components.pptx_contract: Rectangle, solid fill, no line (outline: 1 pt Medium Gray line).

components.name: Line
components.summary: Rules and connector lines. Weights: 0.75 (hairline), 1 (connector), 1.5 (strong), 3 and 6 (accent).
components.pptx_contract: Line shape; dashes as 4/3 pt dash pattern; arrowheads as line-end type 'arrow'.

components.name: Geometric shape
components.summary: Native preset shapes the components use. Square corners throughout; circles only where the meaning needs them (Harvey balls, gauges, Venn and cycle nodes).
components.pptx_contract: Preset geometries: rect, chevron, homePlate, rightArrow, diamond, triangle, star5, trapezoid, ellipse.

components.name: Image
components.summary: Photos fill their frame (cover, with a focal point). Logos fit inside it (contain) and keep clear space.
components.pptx_contract: Picture with srcRect crop computed from the focal point; logos never cropped.

components.name: Icon
components.summary: 42 pt grid, 2 pt line, round caps; Grounded, Magenta or White. These seven are placeholders behind a stable name, so the official suite can replace them without changing any layout.
components.pptx_contract: Vector picture or freeform group named icon/<name>.

components.name: Indicators
components.summary: Small marks that encode a value: status squares, rating units, legend swatches and Harvey balls (0, ¼, ½, ¾, full).
components.pptx_contract: Rectangles; Harvey balls as an ellipse outline plus a 'pie' preset with its angle adjusted.

components.name: Number format
components.summary: One formatter for every figure: currency with K/M/B scale, percent, ranges, deltas and units. Components take a raw value and a format instead of a typed string.
components.pptx_contract: Formatted text runs; charts use matching number-format codes in the embedded workbook (e.g. $#,##0.0,,"M").

components.name: Slide header
components.summary: Top of every content slide. Sits in the header zone, y 36–108.

components.name: Display header
components.summary: Covers, dividers and statement slides. The highlight sits inside the line and may wrap with it.

components.name: Section heading
components.summary: Divides the body of a slide into parts. Ink, rule and lead-in are all options.

components.name: Column heading
components.summary: Heads a column of content. The top rule takes any ink, including series colors for color-coding.

components.name: Group label
components.summary: A quiet divider between groups of content: Mono label on a rule.

components.name: Statement
components.summary: The takeaway sentence inside the body. Heading style in any ink that passes on its surface.

components.name: Text block
components.summary: The basic unit of copy: a short title over body text.

components.name: Lists
components.summary: Normal lists behave like HTML ul and ol. Strong lists add a bold lead-in or a Mono number in its own column. Every list uses a hanging indent, so wrapped lines align with the first line of text.

components.name: Card types
components.summary: One card structure, many presets. Each is the same container with a different body.

components.name: Title band cards
components.summary: The title sits on its own surface, with inks for that surface. The body keeps the card surface.

components.name: Card row (numbered)
components.summary: Numbering is a native option on a card row. The number sits inline with the title, or in a title band.

components.name: Icon cards
components.summary: Three icon layouts: stacked above the title, inline with the title, or in a side column with the content to its right. Icons are placeholders until the icon suite is available.

components.name: Badge cards
components.summary: An icon, image or number overhangs one corner by half its size, breaking the edge of the card.

components.name: Card options
components.summary: Accent edges and title ink, shown on the same text card. Roles remap per surface (emphasis is Blue on light and Magenta on dark), so most failures are avoided by design; the rest are flagged.

components.name: Card states
components.summary: Featured, de-emphasized and placeholder states, plus a checklist body. No state text is hard-coded: the tag, placeholder text and checklist labels are slots.
components.pptx_contract: Same shapes as the card; the tag is a small rectangle with text; checklist marks are squares with a check path.

components.name: Mini bio card
components.summary: One person, compact, for composing 2–4 people on a slide or embedding a person in other content. The full-page bio is a template, not this card.
components.pptx_contract: Card shapes, a picture, tags and text boxes.

components.name: Mini case study card
components.summary: A past engagement, compact, for composing 2–3 on a slide or embedding one in larger content. A metric badge overhangs the top-right corner with the client's scale (revenue, entities). The full-page case study is a template.
components.pptx_contract: Card shapes and text boxes; results as Mono figures.

components.name: Highlight
components.summary: Four official marker shapes. By default they alternate in order of use across a deck; any use can pin a shape. Inline, wraps with the text, Yellow only, on White and the lighter grays.
components.pptx_contract: Picture behind the phrase, scaled to the measured phrase bounds; one picture per line fragment when the phrase wraps.

components.name: Underscore, circle and spark
components.summary: Inline hand-drawn emphasis for any surface. Underscore sits under a phrase, circle surrounds a word or number, spark sits at the top-right of a word.
components.pptx_contract: Filled vector artwork (picture or freeform), placed from the measured phrase bounds.

components.name: Hand-drawn arrows
components.summary: Four official arrows for annotation: right-angle, double, connecting and dashed. Flip and rotate in 90° steps to point any direction. Structure uses geometric connectors; these are for pointing a reader at something.
components.pptx_contract: Filled vector artwork with flip and rotation set on the shape.

components.name: Whiteboard grid
components.summary: The official 15 × 15 dot tile at 100% (3 pt dots every 18 pt), in Medium or Light Gray, on White only. Anchor it to the left or right margin. Tile it every 270 pt to cover more area; the dot spacing continues across tiles.
components.pptx_contract: One picture per tile (SVG with PNG fallback), placed on the 18 pt lattice; or a group of 225 small squares when it must stay editable.

components.name: Squares on the grid
components.summary: One to three squares frame a photo, a color or key type. They align to the dots and at least one edge touches or crosses an outer edge of the grid.
components.pptx_contract: Rectangles or square-cropped pictures, positioned on the 18 pt lattice.

components.name: Labeled block
components.summary: A rectangle with centered text: the unit of pod diagrams, capability maps and simple architectures.

components.name: Chevron
components.summary: Geometric, square-cornered process shapes. The first has a flat left edge; the rest are notched. One module of point depth.

components.name: Text arrow
components.summary: A block arrow with text in the shaft. Arrows chain into a flow, span a transition, or point down to a result.

components.name: Deliverable thumbnail
components.summary: A small image of a real deliverable page: hairline border, optional stack of pages behind it, caption below. Without an image it draws a placeholder page of the named kind.
components.pptx_contract: Picture with a 0.75 pt Medium Gray outline; stacked pages are two offset white rectangles behind it; caption is a text box.

components.name: Connector
components.summary: Straight or elbow lines between shapes, 1 pt Grounded, with a geometric arrowhead. Optional label, and a dashed style for future or optional flows.

components.name: Node
components.summary: A labeled block with an icon, for architecture and system diagrams.

components.name: Group frame
components.summary: Groups shapes into a system, team or boundary. A label tab marks the group.

components.name: Layer stack
components.summary: Horizontal layers with a label column and cells. A cross-cutting bar spans all layers.

components.name: Pod
components.summary: A team unit: title band, then role tiles. Pods sit side by side with shared roles below.

components.name: Metric
components.summary: A number outside a card: primary value, optional change, and optional secondary values.

components.name: Metric additions
components.summary: Metrics take a raw value plus a number format, and can show a target, a range or a source line.
components.pptx_contract: Text runs; status as a small square.

components.name: Legend
components.summary: Explains color-coding anywhere: charts, Gantt bars, team diagrams, maps. Horizontal or vertical, with square, line or marker swatches.

components.name: Callout and quote
components.summary: The Magenta callout fits its content: a label, a value, a short line and an optional secondary. Quotes default to a Blue mark (White on dark); Magenta is an option.

components.name: Gauge
components.summary: A semicircle of 5 or 6 segments, each colored separately from the palette, with a needle that points to a value. For maturity, risk or readiness on one scale.
components.pptx_contract: blockArc preset per segment (adjusted start and end angles); needle as a thin isosceles triangle with a circle hub, rotated to the value.

components.name: Draft review note
components.summary: A working note for drafting with collaborators: owner, due date, status and notes, at a fixed height with room to write. It lives off the slide: only its status tab peeks into the slide's top-right corner, and you scroll past the slide edge in PowerPoint to read it.
components.pptx_contract: A group named wm-review/<slide id> at x 942 pt, y 0: 18 pt of the tab on the slide, the rest on the pasteboard. Status tab, header text, four legend chips and a notes box. Fields mirrored into slide metadata.

components.name: Matrix
components.summary: Rows of small labelled cells. Labels above each row make a layer map (an architecture legend); labels on the left with column heads make a wave or state grid (cutover waves, maturity by area). One row can carry a Magenta outline to point at it.
components.pptx_contract: Grouped rectangles with text; the outline is a separate no-fill rectangle with a 1.5 pt Magenta line.

components.name: Architecture diagram
components.summary: System and solution architecture built from nestable containers (region, boundary, layer), nodes, database cylinders, devices, isometric layer planes and connectors. Containers nest to any depth; layers can stack, expand, or branch off to external systems.
components.pptx_contract: Rectangles (solid, dashed), can preset for cylinders, diamond and parallelogram presets for planes, icon pictures, elbow connectors attached to connection sites; grouped per container.

components.name: Swimlane process
components.summary: Who does what, in what order: actor lanes, steps placed by lane and column, decisions as diamonds, and elbow connectors routed between them. Pain points can be flagged on any step.
components.pptx_contract: Rectangles, diamond presets and elbow connectors attached to connection sites; lanes as rectangles behind.

components.name: Cycle and hub-and-spoke
components.summary: Repeating processes and central capabilities: 3–5 nodes on a circle with arrows between them, optionally around a hub; or a hub with spokes out to its nodes.
components.pptx_contract: Rectangles with text; arc arrows as freeform curves with arrowheads; spokes as straight connectors.

components.name: Pyramid and funnel
components.summary: Horizontal bands that narrow: a pyramid for layered priorities or needs, a funnel for stages with counts and conversion.
components.pptx_contract: Trapezoid presets with text; descriptions as text boxes.

components.name: Before / after
components.summary: Paired rows of today versus the target state with a transition arrow between them, and an optional metric on the target side.
components.pptx_contract: Rectangles with text and a right-arrow preset per row.

components.name: Person tile
components.summary: A compact person: initials or photo square, name and role. Optional org tag for client or partner people.

components.name: Role tile
components.summary: A role without a named person: title, allocation and an edge that color-codes the organization.

components.name: Stepper
components.summary: Steps on a rule with square markers: done (Grounded), current (Magenta, larger) and upcoming (outline).

components.name: Vertical stepper
components.summary: Steps down a column with square markers on a rule: done, current and upcoming. For processes that need more text per step.
components.pptx_contract: Squares on a line; text boxes.

components.name: Phase header
components.summary: Heads a phase column or Gantt band: a color rule, phase number, name and duration.

components.name: Time axis
components.summary: The shared scale for timelines, roadmaps and Gantt charts: ticks, Mono period labels, milestones and a today line.

components.name: Column and bar chart
components.summary: Compare values across categories, or show composition. Columns for time and short labels; horizontal bars for long category names and rankings.
components.pptx_contract: Native barChart (barDir col or bar; grouping clustered, stacked or percentStacked) with an embedded workbook; data labels on; series outline 1 pt Grounded.

components.name: Line chart
components.summary: Change over time. End labels name each series and its last value; an optional dashed target line.
components.pptx_contract: Native lineChart; the Grounded edge is a second, wider series line beneath; target as an extra series with a dash style.

components.name: Pie and doughnut
components.summary: Part-to-whole with few parts. Pies start at 12 o'clock, largest first, clockwise, with direct labels on leader lines. Doughnuts put a headline number in the center.
components.pptx_contract: Native pieChart or doughnutChart, firstSliceAng 0, no explosion; labels with leader lines; center text as a text box.

components.name: Scatter chart
components.summary: The relationship between two measures. Label only the points that matter; optional size for a third measure (bubble).
components.pptx_contract: Native scatterChart or bubbleChart.

components.name: 2×2 quadrant chart
components.summary: Plot items against two dimensions and say which quadrants to aim for and which to stay out of. Any number of quadrants can be marked desirable or undesirable; every marked quadrant carries a text tag. The strong variant fills one quadrant in Grounded or Magenta.
components.pptx_contract: Drawn shapes (rectangles, markers, text boxes); a native scatter when positions are real data, with quadrant shading as background shapes.

components.name: Annotation
components.summary: A callout attached to one hand-drawn arrow. The arrow's tip touches the named target and the callout hangs from its tail. The arrow keeps its natural proportions and only flips or turns in 90° steps; the placement decides which.
components.pptx_contract: Arrow artwork as a picture or freeform with flip and 90° rotation; the callout as a rectangle with text; positions solved from the target's bounds.

components.name: Table
components.summary: Rows of 2 modules with typed cells. Optional spanning group headers, a row-header column, total rows, footnote markers and a 'continued' header for tables that run onto the next slide. Presets cover RACI, fee schedules and requirement maps.

components.name: Pricing set
components.summary: Consulting pricing built from cards and table presets: an option set, a fee summary, the payment milestone schedule (fee schedule preset), a capacity plan and assumptions. Covers fixed fee, capacity-based, time and materials, hybrid and outcome-linked models.
components.pptx_contract: Cards (rectangles and text), native tables with total rows, allocation bars as rectangles.

components.name: Phase columns
components.summary: The phased approach: one column per phase with its objective, activities and deliverables, an optional gate at the end, and a 'we are here' marker on the current phase.
components.pptx_contract: Rules, rectangles and text boxes per column; gates as diamonds with labels.

components.name: Roadmap
components.summary: A lighter view than the Gantt for executive audiences: initiatives as chips in swimlanes, on dated quarters or on Now / Next / Later horizons.
components.pptx_contract: Rectangles and text; the dated version reuses the Gantt layout.

components.name: Org chart
components.summary: Who reports to whom, laid out from a tree: reporting lines as elbows, dotted-line relationships dashed, organizations color-coded on the tile edge with a legend, and placeholders for roles to be filled.
components.pptx_contract: Rectangles with text and elbow connectors attached to connection sites; not SmartArt.

components.name: Governance stack
components.summary: How decisions get made: governance tiers top to bottom, each with its cadence, members and decision rights, and an escalation path between tiers.
components.pptx_contract: Rectangles, chips and text boxes; escalation as up arrows.

components.name: Gantt
components.summary: Periods grouped into phases; a sidebar of workstreams and activities; any number of items per activity row, stacking onto sub-rows when they overlap. Bars can be solid, hatched (in progress or tentative), partly complete, or have hatched soft starts and ends. Gates are dashed vertical lines with labels; events are stars, triangles, diamonds and flag tags with text.
components.pptx_contract: Bars are rectangles (hatching = native pattern fill, e.g. wdDnDiag, in the bar color on White). Gates are dashed lines. Events are preset shapes (star5, triangle, diamond) with text boxes. Tags are pentagon arrows pointing left. All positions resolve to points from the period grid.

templates.name: Work plan · eight weeks
templates.purpose: An eight-week work plan: three workstreams, phase bands, gates, workshops and soft starts, for the detailed plan a steering group signs off.

templates.name: Phased approach · four phases
templates.purpose: The approach as four phases, each with objective, activities, deliverables and a closing gate.

templates.name: Phases · key activities and outcome
templates.purpose: Three consecutive phases as arrows sized to their weeks, each with a number, name, key activities and one outcome, so a steering group reads the whole arc at once.

templates.name: Phases · summary, activities and deliverables
templates.purpose: Three phase columns under arrow heads: a one-line summary band, a block of activities and a block of deliverables, aligned across phases so they compare row by row.

templates.name: Phase detail · activities and work products
templates.purpose: One phase on one page: a rail with the phase name, objective and exit criteria; activities and work products by workstream; deliverable thumbnails and assumptions.

templates.name: Phase detail · repeatable process matrix
templates.purpose: A phase rail beside a step-by-step matrix of platform service, workload activity and evidence, with the fixed and variable scope stated underneath.

templates.name: Phase detail · scorecard and cohort
templates.purpose: A phase rail carrying the selection scorecard, beside three illustrative workloads that each validate one pattern, with a thumbnail of the architecture each touches.

templates.name: Phase · team handoff over time
templates.purpose: Show how responsibility shifts between consulting and client teams across two phases, with an effort curve, a callout and a row per team.

templates.name: Phase gate · criteria, exit and owner
templates.purpose: The decision rule for a phase gate: five numbered criteria, the evidence each requires, an illustrative exit and one named decision owner.

templates.name: Roadmap · staggered phases and milestones
templates.purpose: A months-based roadmap where each phase starts as the last one settles: staggered bars with hatched extension windows, starred milestones, and an ongoing program lane.

templates.name: Cutover · AI support and wave matrix
templates.purpose: How a phased cutover is run: three kinds of AI support across every wave, then a slice-by-wave matrix showing legacy, coexistence and modern state.

templates.name: Argument with takeaway rail
templates.purpose: Evidence on the left and the so-what in a dark right rail.

templates.name: From to, two cards
templates.purpose: Contrast the current state (subtle) with the target state (inverse) and one hand-drawn arrow.

templates.name: From to, paired rows
templates.purpose: Row-by-row shift from today to the target state, with a metric on the target side.

templates.name: Transformation · before and after
templates.purpose: Paired rows of today against the target model, with a transition arrow and a Magenta tag for each result.

templates.name: Transformation · pain points to design themes
templates.purpose: Pair each current pain point with the design theme that answers it, joined by an arrow, with one closing statement of how the problems were solved.

templates.name: Method · what it is and seven steps
templates.purpose: A proprietary method on one page: a panel that says what it is, what the client gets and why it works, beside the seven steps of how it runs.

templates.name: Pillars · four, each with why it matters
templates.purpose: Set out four principles of an approach, each with its practices and an offset Grounded panel stating why it matters to the client.

templates.name: Capability table · focus, AI role, human judgment
templates.purpose: Walk a five-step progression in one table with a tile per step, what the technology does, where human judgment stays, and a one-line takeaway.

templates.name: Capability map · six layered bands
templates.purpose: Show an operating or architecture model as ruled bands, each with a label column and rows of blocks that span the width in different splits.

templates.name: Flow · challenges to products, use cases and outcomes
templates.purpose: Trace a causal chain from challenges through products and use cases to outcomes, in four framed zones joined by arrows, with a closing statement.

templates.name: Problem · two causes, one statistic and a remedy
templates.purpose: Frame a problem with a lead sentence, two causes in icon cards, one Grounded statistic card that carries the headline number, and a one-line remedy strip.

templates.name: Decision · two options and the shifting economics
templates.purpose: Compare two options side by side with when each fits and its trade-offs, and set the changing economics in a wider third column, ending on a decision rule.

templates.name: Objective · numbered rationale beside a Grounded outcomes panel
templates.purpose: State a session or program objective with three numbered reasons on the left and a Grounded panel of six outcomes in two columns on the right.

templates.name: Session · step sequence with a guidance panel
templates.purpose: Lay out how a working session runs as a four-step vertical sequence, with a Grounded panel on facilitation and a closing ask of participants.

templates.name: Goal and steps · target band over three timed steps
templates.purpose: Open with a Grounded goal band and a target outcome, then three timed numbered steps each with a facilitator note, and a closing expected-outcome bar.

templates.name: Comparison · our way versus others, with six implications
templates.purpose: Contrast two ways of working in paired lists, then spell out six implications for the client with an icon tile each, beside a short narrative and a handover callout.

templates.name: Hub and eight spokes
templates.purpose: A dark hub of benefits ringed by eight supporting capabilities, each tied to the hub with an arrow.

templates.name: Frameworks · layers, examples and emphasis
templates.purpose: Lay out a set of numbered framework layers with public examples, what each emphasizes and its maturity, closing with a call to action.

templates.name: Pricing · three options
templates.purpose: Present two to three engagement options side by side with one recommended, so the client compares scope and fee on one page.

templates.name: Pricing · fixed fee by milestone
templates.purpose: Show a fixed fee as payments tied to milestones, with one summary of the total and terms. Never itemize by person.

templates.name: Pricing · capacity run-rate
templates.purpose: Show a capacity-based team as allocations and one monthly run-rate, never as individual rates.

templates.name: Scope · optional services, scope and value
templates.purpose: Optional scope laid out by service: what is added, the value it unlocks and how it is priced, in one dense table a sponsor can strike items from.

templates.name: Key stats, four metrics
templates.purpose: Four headline numbers that prove one claim, with a single supporting sentence.

templates.name: Key stats, circled headline
templates.purpose: One circled headline number with two supporting metric cards.

templates.name: Chart, full width
templates.purpose: One column chart across the slide, with the takeaway in the title and the key bars highlighted.

templates.name: Chart with takeaway rail
templates.purpose: A clustered chart on the left and the so-what in a dark right rail.

templates.name: 2x2 assessment, subtle
templates.purpose: Rank initiatives by value and effort; the aim-here quadrant is tinted, the avoid quadrant hatched.

templates.name: 2x2 assessment, strong
templates.purpose: One filled quadrant to stay out of, with movement arrows and a short note alongside.

templates.name: Image with text, square
templates.purpose: A photo square beside the point it supports and two short proof lines.

templates.name: Image with text, wide frame
templates.purpose: Text on the left with a 16:9 photo on the right and a one-line caption.

templates.name: Status dashboard, four panels
templates.purpose: Four panels on one grid: two metric cards with status, a wave table and an adoption card.

templates.name: Value · capacity to banked savings
templates.purpose: A stacked capacity chart that shows effort moving from manual work to priority work and savings, paired with the five governance steps that make the value count.

templates.name: Cover · photo with contacts
templates.purpose: Opening slide for a proposal: logo, client, display title, preparer and two contacts on White; a photo bleeding off the right edge, framed by an L of dots.

templates.name: Cover · whiteboard grid and stat square
templates.purpose: Opening slide that leads with a number: whiteboard dot grid with one inverse stat square.

templates.name: Agenda · left panel with photo
templates.purpose: Section overview with page references. The title sits on the dark panel; a photo breaks out across the panel edge, over a column of dots.

templates.name: Agenda · schedule rows
templates.purpose: Timed agenda for a workshop or readout: time keys on the left, one outcome on the right.

templates.name: Agenda · sessions, contributions and results
templates.purpose: A working-session day as rows: the session and its time, what each side contributes, and the shared result at the end of the session.

templates.name: Divider · panel with breakout photo
templates.purpose: A Grounded panel holds the section number and title; a photo crosses the panel edge onto the dot field.

templates.name: Divider · panel with Magenta edge
templates.purpose: Grounded panel with a Magenta edge and the section label; the photo fills the white side, over a band of dots.

templates.name: Divider · full-bleed photo
templates.purpose: A full-bleed photo with the number and title on a Grounded block anchored bottom-left; dots run across the block's top edge.

templates.name: Divider · light with photo square
templates.purpose: Opens a section on White: oversized section number, display title, a photo square over the dot field.

templates.name: Divider · inverse with photo
templates.purpose: Opens a section on Grounded Blue: display title low-left, an abstract photo square top-right, Dark Gray dots beneath it.

templates.name: Key message · claim with one proof
templates.purpose: One claim in the title; the key message at title size and its support at lead size, centered as a group in the body beside one number that proves it.

templates.name: Key message · statement
templates.purpose: The message is the slide: a display-size statement centered on White, with one line of support and the dot field to its right.

templates.name: Narrative · lead and three points
templates.purpose: A short argument in prose at reading width: one lead sentence, three lead-in points.

templates.name: Cards · three columns
templates.purpose: Three parallel ideas as numbered cards with a Grounded Blue band.

templates.name: Cards · four columns
templates.purpose: Four short parallel ideas on subtle cards with inline numbers.

templates.name: Quote · light
templates.purpose: A client voice in their own words at heading size, with a single quiet square.

templates.name: Quote · inverse
templates.purpose: The same quote on Grounded Blue for a section or deck opener.

templates.name: Closing · tagline
templates.purpose: Brand sign-off on Grounded Blue with the tagline and one next step.

templates.name: Case study · full page
templates.purpose: One past engagement told on a full page: image, challenge, approach, and three results on a right rail. Built from an image, header, text blocks and metrics, not a card.

templates.name: Case study · full page with quote
templates.purpose: Full-width case study: image, two text blocks, three results and a client quote. Use when a quote carries the proof.

templates.name: Case study · narrative, exhibits and results
templates.purpose: Anonymized case study with a situation and approach narrative, an architecture exhibit, headline results and a question-to-value mapping.

templates.name: Three case studies
templates.purpose: Three mini case study cards with client-scale badges. The badges overhang the top-right corners inside the content margin.

templates.name: Two case studies
templates.purpose: Two wider case study cards with a third action line each, for a tighter story.

templates.name: Proof · result cards and client quotes
templates.purpose: Back a proposal with two anonymized result cards, two headline survey statistics and a row of client quotes.

templates.name: RFP requirements map
templates.purpose: Reference table that maps each RFP requirement to how the response meets it and where. Appendix density, with a continued caption for tables that run over.

templates.name: Confidentiality notice
templates.purpose: A calm text slide: a lead paragraph, a rule and three short notes. The stamp carries the status.

templates.name: Partnership history
templates.purpose: A time axis with four milestones, three short year notes beneath and one Magenta callout for where the work leads.

templates.name: Outcomes · three client programs
templates.purpose: Prove one claim with three comparable client programs, each with its situation, two headline metrics and the business value delivered.

templates.name: Offerings and capabilities · three panels
templates.purpose: A lead statement with alliance chips, a dark panel of industry offerings in three groups, and a light panel of four capability groups.

templates.name: Sample deliverables · four columns of exhibits
templates.purpose: Show the rigor behind each deliverable: four columns, each with a name, a one-line scope and two sample exhibits.

templates.name: About us · firm at a glance
templates.purpose: Summarize the firm: a positioning statement, a client quote, what and where we work, and three proof statistics on a dark panel.

templates.name: Architecture · layer stack
templates.purpose: A numbered layer stack inside one frame: the experience layer first, three rows beneath, and a cross-cutting controls column.

templates.name: Architecture · nested view
templates.purpose: A nested deployment view: source systems outside, one cloud tenant, one finance platform boundary, and two layers inside.

templates.name: Architecture · legend and layer map
templates.purpose: A colour-keyed legend of the five architecture layers beside a dense six-group component map: users, lifecycle, platform services, governance, placement and ecosystem.

templates.name: Architecture · inputs, core and integrations
templates.purpose: A three-zone product architecture (inputs, analysis core with a database, integrations), a dark panel of differentiators and a value strip of three headline numbers.

templates.name: Reference architecture · platform map
